name: LindenBot
summary: LindenBot is a Hefei robotics company backed by iFLYTEK. It develops embodied intelligence models and robot hardware as integrated systems for industrial tasks. The company’s LDB01 platform combines a mobile body, lifting torso and coordinated dual arms with perception and task-planning software. LindenBot targets manufacturing and logistics applications, including automotive and electronics production.
